real emitted library module with its original byte SHA
successful module emission for target14 from real library inputs
successful unchanged approved public bridge typecheck against that real module at14
all actual library source and bridge SHA before/after, matching the final source/API evidence
original fresh logs and explicit no-link/no-launch scope
